item.title: Bank of Canada Board launches process to fill external Deputy Governor position
item.description: The Board of Directors of the Bank of Canada has initiated a recruitment process to fill the external Deputy Governor position left vacant by the appointment of Nicolas Vincent as a full-time Deputy Governor.

cb:news.cb:simpleTitle: Bank of Canada Board launches process to fill external Deputy Governor position

item.title: Bank of Canada unveils new vertical $20 bank note
item.description: Her Excellency the Right Honourable Louise Arbour, Governor General of Canada, and the Honourable Wayne Long, Secretary of State (Canada Revenue Agency and Financial Institutions), joined Bank of Canada Governor Tiff Macklem today at an event to unveil Canada’s new vertical $20 bank note featuring a portrait of His Majesty King Charles III.

cb:news.cb:simpleTitle: Bank of Canada unveils new vertical $20 bank note

item.title: Bank of Canada maintains the policy rate at 2¼%
item.description: The Bank of Canada today held its target for the overnight rate at 2.25%, with the Bank Rate at 2.5% and the deposit rate at 2.20%.

cb:news.cb:simpleTitle: Bank of Canada maintains the policy rate at 2¼%

item.title: G7 2026 Cross-Border Coordination Exercise (CBCE)
item.description: The G7 Cyber Expert Group (CEG) successfully concluded its 2026 Cross-border coordination exercise (CBCE) on May 18, 2026. This exercise demonstrates the Group’s ongoing commitment to strengthening cyber resilience across the G7 financial sector.
